name: timebase
description: Connect your AI agent to TimeBase, a high-performance database for financial market and other time-series data, via MCP tools and skills for QQL query and TimeBase client code generation.

settings.name: TimeBase URL
settings.description: Optional TimeBase native connection URL. When left unset, TimeBase MCP defaults to dxtick://localhost:8011.

settings.name: Username
settings.description: Optional username for basic auth or as an override for OAuth2 client credentials.

settings.name: Password
settings.description: Optional password for basic auth. Mutually exclusive with OAuth2 client credentials.

settings.name: Read-only mode
settings.description: Optional flag to open TimeBase connections in read-only mode.

settings.name: TimeBase HTTP URL
settings.description: Optional TimeBase HTTP API base URL override.

settings.name: OAuth2 token URL
settings.description: Optional OAuth2 token endpoint for client credentials auth.

settings.name: OAuth2 token params
settings.description: Optional JSON object of extra OAuth2 token form parameters.

settings.name: SSL termination
settings.description: Optional flag to enable SSL termination when connecting to TimeBase.

settings.name: SSL certificate file
settings.description: Optional path to a DER certificate file.

settings.name: Trust all SSL certificates
settings.description: Optional flag to disable SSL certificate verification.

settings.name: MCP host
settings.description: Optional loopback host used for local interactive OAuth redirects.

settings.name: MCP port
settings.description: Optional loopback port used for local interactive OAuth redirects.

settings.name: Log level
settings.description: Optional log verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.
